AI & How I Use It

This site was built together with opencode, an AI assistant that lives in my terminal. This page explains how AI fits into who I am as a learner — and how I keep the understanding mine.

🧠 My Toolbox

opencode — an AI coding assistant in the terminal. It writes the code, explains concepts, and talks through the changes with me.

It's the main tool behind this site. Every page here passed through my own review before going live.

🛠️ Skills I've Built

A small library of custom skills for opencode itself. The first one summarizes YouTube videos by stepping down from cheap to heavy — metadata first, then captions, and local transcription only when neither exists. They live in the cerfly/ai repository, and same rule as the site: it writes, I review and decide what stays.

🤝 How I Use AI

As a patient tutor: I ask questions, it explains, I apply.

As a rubber duck: I explain my problem — to it or out loud — until the fix becomes obvious.

As a pair programmer: it drafts, I review, edit, and own the result.

🚫 Where I Draw the Line

I try not to ship code I can't explain. AI suggests; I decide what stays.

I'll be honest — I don't read every line. But I review what ships, and watching it write code line by line is something I genuinely enjoy. AI can speed up learning, but the understanding still has to be mine.
